source:
@@U02155@@
Run! Keep on the path by the brook,
over the bridge,
into the woods,
on the left,
there,
by the fence,
in the pond!
Grab it! Hurry!
It’s trying to rise!
Kicking!
Save it! Save it!

@@U02157@@
Come to your senses!
One step and you're free!

@@U02159@@
If only we were past the hill!
My mother sits there on a stone,
a cold hand grabs me by the hair!
My mother sits there on a stone,
wagging her head.
She doesn't wave,
doesn’t nod,
her head’s so heavy,
she slept so long she'll never wake up.
She slept so we could enjoy ourselves.
Those were happy times.

@@U02161@@
If pleading and reasoning do no good,
I'll carry you off by force.

@@U02163@@
Don't touch me, don’t!
I won't have violence!
Don’t grab me so murderously!
You know I once did everything you asked.
translation:
@@U02155@@
跑！继续沿着小溪边的小路走，
过了桥，
走进树林，
在左边，
在那里，
在栅栏旁，
在池塘里！
抓住它！匆忙！
它正在努力崛起！
踢！
保存它！保存它！

@@U02157@@
醒悟吧！
迈出一步，你就自由了！

@@U02159@@
要是我们过了山就好了！
我妈妈坐在一块石头上，
一只冰冷的手抓住了我的头发！
我妈妈坐在一块石头上，
摇摇头。
她没有挥手，
没有点头，
她的头好重，
她睡得太久了，永远不会醒来。
她睡了，所以我们可以尽情享受。
那是一段快乐的时光。

@@U02161@@
如果恳求和推理没有用，
我会用武力把你带走。

@@U02163@@
别碰我，别碰我！
我不会暴力！
别这么凶狠地抓我！
你知道我曾经做过你要求的一切。
